name: @pbgo/pipeline
description: `pnpm game-flow`: what the skill `/add-game` keeps its state with. A game goes from its name to live in ten steps, each carried out by a sub-agent with the skill of that step and each ending at a gate that the owner answers in the chat; this package holds the state of a game (`<assets>/<slug>/pipeline.json`), the steps and their checks, the brief of a sub-agent, the Linear bookkeeping and the fetch of a rulebook, so that none of it is improvised. `bin/` holds the entry Node runs (type stripping), `src/` the parts.
